race.comment: SAVITRI (2) was well backed first up at Sandown Hillside but just did a bit wrong in the small field and held her ground into fourth. She'd gone through the grades nicely as a 3yo filly and with the added fitness and extra trip she can atone. NAINA (6) was well backed last time and just got held up at a key stage at Caulfield Heath, beaten a neck. Gets a nice draw here and can atone. CELESTIAL ZARA (4) was behind OCEAN BAY last time but had won two in a row prior and gets every chance to turn the tables on speed. MISS CASTELVECCHIO (7) was a good winner last start and has to be included off the back of that effort.
